author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಡೆದ ಕಲ್ಲುಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಮೂರ್ತಿಯಾಗುವವೇನು?
ಪಡೆದ ಪುಣ್ಯದ ರಾಶಿಯದಕೆ ನಿರ್ಭರವು
ಕೊಡತಿಯೇಟನು ಸಹಿಸಿ ಪುಣ್ಯಫಲಗಳು ಸೇರೆ
ಪಡೆಯುವೆವು ವಿಗ್ರಹವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Does every carved stone become a sacred image?
That rests upon the store of merit it has earned;
when, bearing the mallet's blows, the fruits of merit gather,
we receive the holy image, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Not every stone that is carved becomes an image fit for worship; it takes merit, and the patience to bear the sculptor's blows. A person too is shaped into something sacred by enduring hardship.
